podcast.body: The first single released from Pink's compilation album, "Greatest Hits, So Far." Co-written by Pink with Max Martin and his songwriting associate Carl Martin Schuster (Shellback), its lyrics were described as brilliant, celebratory, and self-referential, filled with gratitude for Pink's fans, referring to them as "all my underdogs, we will never be, never be anything but loud, and nitty-gritty, dirty little freaks." By December 2010, the song rose to number one on the Hot 100. "The first single from Greatest Hits So Far was Raise Your Glass, co-written by Pink with Max Martin and his songwriting associate Carl Martin Schuster, aka Shellback."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: This song was one of five or more top 10 hits Pink scored between 2010 and 2013, during her more impressive imperial run where she reached a "whole new level of imperiality." "The pink of Raise Your Glass blow me one last kiss and just give me a reason among others was at a whole new level of imperiality."
